run.question:
Alertmanager alert RequestErrorRate (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/frontend since 2026-11-16T23:17:00Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The RequestErrorRate warning for otel-demo/frontend is explained by a failed rollout of Deployment otel-demo/product-catalog. At 23:15:09Z the deployment created ReplicaSet product-catalog-fcf7564cf whose pod template sets the container command to ["invalid-command"] while keeping image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-product-catalog, and the previous ReplicaSet product-catalog-7c7f8b68dc (command null) was scaled to 0 at 23:15:18Z. The kubelet refuses to create the container with exec: "invalid-command": executable file not found in $PATH; pod product-catalog-fcf7564cf-vjj7l is Running but not ready in CrashLoopBackOff with restartCount 5 and lastState StartError exitCode 128, and the Deployment reports MinimumReplicasUnavailable. Service product-catalog lists only notReadyAddresses, so no request can be served. product-catalog span traffic falls from about 9.8/s to 0 from the 23:19Z sample, and the services that call it begin failing on their own product-catalog client spans at the same time as frontend's error spans: checkout's oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct and recommendation's /oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/ListProducts turn STATUS_CODE_ERROR, matching the PlaceOrder and ListRecommendations errors frontend sees. Frontend's own error spans (GET /api/products/{productId}, GET /api/recommendations, POST /api/checkout and matching downstream client spans) start at the 23:17:00Z sample, and frontend-proxy ingress errors rise to about 5.85/s. Frontend itself was not changed (Deployment generation 1, pod ready, 0 restarts); its errors mirror its dependencies' failures. What changed the product-catalog Deployment cannot be determined here because change history is not integrated.

claims.text: Frontend's error-span rate was 0 through the 23:15:00Z sample and became nonzero at the 23:17:00Z sample, reaching about 23.22 spans/s by 23:25:00Z, matching the alert start 2026-11-16T23:17:00Z.

Frontend's error spans are carried by its own route spans GET /api/products/{productId}, GET /api/recommendations, POST /api/checkout, GET, POST and by client spans grpc.oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct, grpc.oteldemo.RecommendationService/ListRecommendations, grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder and tcp.connect; at 23:25:00Z GET /api/products/{productId} error rate 4.3669/s equals grpc.oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct 4.3669/s.

Deployment otel-demo/product-catalog (generation 4, image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-product-catalog) sets the product-catalog container command to ["invalid-command"] with args null; its other settings (PRODUCT_CATALOG_PORT 8080, OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT http://$(OTEL_COLLECTOR_NAME):4317) are unchanged.
Deployment product-catalog reports Available=False with reason MinimumReplicasUnavailable, unavailableReplicas 1, updatedReplicas 1, replicas 1, observedGeneration 4.

Pod product-catalog-fcf7564cf-vjj7l (owner ReplicaSet product-catalog-fcf7564cf) is Running but not ready: restartCount 5, Ready=False reason ContainersNotReady, container waiting in CrashLoopBackOff with "back-off 2m40s restarting failed container=product-catalog", and lastState terminated reason StartError exitCode 128 with message "failed to create containerd task: ... exec: \"invalid-command\": executable file not found in $PATH".

Events record the rollout and the start failure: ReplicaSet product-catalog-fcf7564cf SuccessfulCreate at 23:15:09Z, Deployment "Scaled up replica set product-catalog-fcf7564cf from 0 to 1", Deployment "Scaled down replica set product-catalog-7c7f8b68dc from 1 to 0" at 23:15:18Z, Warning Failed on product-catalog-fcf7564cf-2fvnx at 23:15:13Z and six times on product-catalog-fcf7564cf-vjj7l (23:15:30Z-23:18:39Z) with the same exec "invalid-command" message, plus 25 BackOff warnings to 23:20:41Z.

Two ReplicaSets belong to Deployment product-catalog: product-catalog-7c7f8b68dc (created 22:45:08Z, command null, replicas 0) and product-catalog-fcf7564cf (created 23:15:09Z, command ["invalid-command"], replicas 1); both use image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-product-catalog, so the rollout changed configuration only.

Service product-catalog has no ready address: its only subset entry lists notReadyAddresses targeting pod product-catalog-fcf7564cf-vjj7l on port 8080, while checkout, frontend, frontend-proxy and recommendation endpoints each have ready addresses.

product-catalog's own span rate collapsed to zero: oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct fell from 9.8074/s (23:15:00Z sample) to 7.8519/s, 2.9630/s and then 0 from 23:19:00Z onward, and oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/ListProducts fell from 0.8444/s to 0.6926/s, 0.2444/s and then 0.

Checkout fails on its product-catalog dependency: its client span oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct moves from STATUS_CODE_UNSET to STATUS_CODE_ERROR reaching 0.5626/s at 23:25:00Z, identical to the ERROR rate of its server span oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder (0.5626/s), while its CartService/GetCart, CurrencyService/Convert and PaymentService/Charge spans stay UNSET.

Recommendation fails on its product-catalog dependency: client span /oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/ListProducts and internal span get_product_list move from STATUS_CODE_UNSET to STATUS_CODE_ERROR (0.8879/s at 23:25:00Z), while its server span /oteldemo.RecommendationService/ListRecommendations is still recorded UNSET.

frontend-proxy shows the user-facing consequence: ingress and "router frontend egress" spans go from about 0.0037/s ERROR at 23:15:00Z to 5.8481/s ERROR at 23:25:00Z while their UNSET rates drop from 10.27/s to 4.57/s.

Frontend's own workload was neither changed nor restarted: Deployment frontend is generation 1 with command null, image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-frontend, readyReplicas 1, Available=True and Progressing=True, and pod frontend-675fd7b5c5-9f6l5 is Running and ready with restartCount 0.

The fault originates in Deployment otel-demo/product-catalog: its pod-template command ["invalid-command"] makes every replacement container fail before the process starts, leaving the product-catalog Service with no ready endpoint from 23:15Z, which propagates as product-catalog, checkout, recommendation, frontend and frontend-proxy error spans.

flagd fault injection is not the cause: every flag in ConfigMap flagd-config key demo.flagd.json is at defaultVariant "off", including productCatalogFailure and recommendationCacheFailure, and no flag can produce a container-init exec failure for "invalid-command" (this is the ConfigMap state at query time, not proof of its value during the window).
Service ad's small error rate (about 0.0037/s at the 23:03:00Z-23:25:00Z samples) was already present before the 23:17Z deviation and stayed flat, so it is background unrelated to this alert.

fraud-detection's restart is not this cause: pod fraud-detection-9fb7d885b-8bpr4 last terminated with reason OOMKilled exitCode 137 at 2026-11-16T23:05:12Z, before the 23:15Z change, then restarted running and ready; the fraud-detection service error-span rate was 0 at every observed sample.

A product-catalog Service selector or port misconfiguration is rejected as the cause: the product-catalog Endpoints object still selects pod product-catalog-fcf7564cf-vjj7l and exposes port 8080 "tcp-service", but only under notReadyAddresses, which is a pod-readiness failure rather than a routing or selector mismatch.

Roll Deployment otel-demo/product-catalog back to revision product-catalog-7c7f8b68dc (remove the command override ["invalid-command"] so the image entrypoint runs), then confirm the product-catalog Endpoints gain a ready address and that checkout and recommendation product-catalog client spans return to STATUS_CODE_UNSET.

Use Kubernetes audit logs or a change-history source to identify what applied the product-catalog container command change at 23:15:09Z, since the deployment spec is the only evidence of the change available in this Run.

gaps: Change history is not an integrated data source in this Run, so who or what changed Deployment otel-demo/product-catalog's container command to ["invalid-command"] at 23:15:09Z is unknown.

The RequestErrorRate alerting rule is not present in the queried Prometheus: list_prometheus_rules with rule_name=RequestErrorRate and with type=alert both returned no_data, so the rule expression and the arithmetic behind the reported value 16.87 could not be verified.

Jaeger returned no traces for service frontend in 23:15:00-23:26:33Z, for service frontend with tags error=true, for recommendation with error=true, or for checkout with error=true (status no_data), and traces_search for product-catalog returned RESULT_TOO_LARGE, so no span-level error message or status attribute for the failing calls was read; the error-path evidence is metric-based.

frontend's application logs on pod frontend-675fd7b5c5-9f6l5 returned 0 bytes (no lines) and checkout and recommendation log reads returned no matching error lines (status no_data), so application-log confirmation of the dependency errors is missing.
The product-catalog container that served traffic until 23:15:18Z (pod product-catalog-7c7f8b68dc-wzpwm) was deleted by its ReplicaSet controller, so its logs and exit history are unavailable.
The flagd-config ConfigMap was read after the incident window, so it cannot prove which flag variants were active at 23:15-23:26Z.

Service-level error spans were observed for frontend, frontend-proxy, checkout, recommendation and background ad only; no error series was returned for accounting, cart, currency, email, fraud-detection, image-provider, payment, product-catalog (whose spans stopped entirely) or shipping, which is a limit of the query result and not a measurement that those services were healthy.
No baseline before 22:57Z was fetched for any latency or duration metric, so no latency trend is asserted in this report.
next_steps: Revert Deployment otel-demo/product-catalog to the previous pod template (drop command ["invalid-command"]) and watch the product-catalog Endpoints become ready and checkout/recommendation client spans return to UNSET.
Retrieve Kubernetes audit logs for namespace otel-demo around 2026-11-16T23:15:09Z to identify the actor or controller that applied the invalid command, since change_history is not integrated here.
Confirm the RequestErrorRate alerting rule's PromQL and the aggregation that produced the value 16.87 on a Prometheus that loads the rule, because the queried instance returned no rule data.
